title: mcp-server
description: Agent-first meeting schedule polls for humans and agents. Create polls, vote, find times.
summary: Agent-first meeting schedule polls for humans and agents. Create polls, vote, find times.
offersHint: Agent-first meeting schedule polls for humans and agents. Create polls, vote, find times. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://meetlark.ai/mcp · Packages: npm:@meetlark/mcp-server

toolsPreview.name: meetlark_create_poll
toolsPreview.description: Create a scheduling poll to find a time that works for a group. Returns an admin URL (keep private) and a participation URL (share with participants). The creator's email must be verified -- if not yet verified, a verification email is sent automatically. Ask the user to check their inbox and click the link, then retry.

toolsPreview.name: meetlark_get_results
toolsPreview.description: Get poll details and available time slots using a participation token. Returns the poll title, description, status, and time slots -- but NOT votes or participant data. This is the view a participant sees before voting. To see who voted and how, use meetlark_get_admin_view instead.

toolsPreview.name: meetlark_vote
toolsPreview.description: Cast a vote on a scheduling poll. Each time slot can be voted yes, maybe, or no. Requires participant name and email. Use the participation token from the poll's participate URL. If the email matches a previous voter on this poll, their response is updated instead of creating a duplicate.

toolsPreview.name: meetlark_get_admin_view
toolsPreview.description: Get full poll details including all votes and participants. This is the only way to see who voted and how they voted. Returns poll info, time slots, every participant's votes (yes/maybe/no per slot), participant emails, and admin URLs. Use the admin token from poll creation. Use this to check vote status or results.

toolsPreview.name: meetlark_close_poll
toolsPreview.description: Close a poll to stop accepting new votes. Use the admin token from poll creation.

toolsPreview.name: meetlark_reopen_poll
toolsPreview.description: Reopen a previously closed poll to accept votes again. Use the admin token from poll creation.
